definition: Per affected brand row: rows in interactions.csv / contraindication.csv / dose_caps.csv that mention any molecule in the row's molecule cell, summed over the affected rows. 'before' uses the class-representative cell the import wrote, 'after' the ingredient the brand string states. Read the direction, not the magnitude: these brands addressed 17 082 interaction rows that describe a DIFFERENT DRUG, and 4 238 that describe the one the patient swallows. A fall here is the false-positive load being removed. The rise in brands_addressing_nothing is the honest cost, and it is the remaining provenance gap (task: close real data-provenance gaps), not a regression in the identity law — the catalog simply holds no rule row for cefotaxime, budesonide inhalation or levosalbutamol yet.
